_note: Backfill for eleven mentions loaded before falsify_match/falsify_miss were required. Nine of them are preparedness instructions, whose only checkable content is the disruption they presuppose; two are explicitly unfalsifiable and are recorded as such rather than given an invented test. Written 2026-08-30, before any outcome was looked up.

amendments.falsify_match: A US food supply disruption severe enough that home milling of grain and stored water become a normal necessity.
amendments.falsify_miss: Retail food and municipal water remain reliable; the instruction is prudent but its premise does not arrive.

amendments.falsify_match: A bank failure, freeze or power outage that locks depositors out of accounts while physical metal stays usable.
amendments.falsify_miss: Account access remains normal; no episode in which paper claims fail and metal does not.

amendments.falsify_match: A water supply interruption making household storage and filtration necessary.
amendments.falsify_miss: Municipal water stays reliable through the window he describes.

amendments.falsify_match: A disruption lasting weeks in which cash, stored food and bottled water are actually needed.
amendments.falsify_miss: No multi-week disruption to payments or supply.

amendments.falsify_match: Barter of goods becomes common because normal payment rails fail.
amendments.falsify_miss: Ordinary payment continues; no barter economy appears.

amendments.falsify_match: Large scale US agricultural production falls far enough that household growing becomes a necessity rather than a hobby.
amendments.falsify_miss: Commercial agriculture keeps supplying food at normal scale.

amendments.falsify_match: A short window in which gold rises sharply and then the opportunity visibly closes.
amendments.falsify_miss: No bounded window: gold moves without an identifiable open and close.

amendments.falsify_match: A major financial or civil storm follows the window he describes.
amendments.falsify_miss: The window passes with no following storm.

amendments.falsify_match: The window opened roughly a year before this telling, consistent with the boundaries he gives elsewhere.
amendments.falsify_miss: His own datings of the window opening are mutually inconsistent by more than a year.

amendments.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as stated: an instruction to the church with no observable outcome attached.
Unfalsifiable within any useful horizon: he explicitly allows the dates he holds to pass.
amendments.falsify_miss: Cannot fail as stated; the caveat absorbs any miss.
